valid:
run PositiveScenario2 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some disj p1, p2 : Photo |
    some d1 : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = p1 + p2
        Ad = p1
        Day = d1
        User <: follows = u1->u2
        User <: sees = u1->p1 + u1->p2 + u2->p1
        User <: posts = u1->p2 + u2->p1
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = p1->d1 + p2->d1
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 1

run NegativeScenario1 {
    some u1 : User |
    some p1 : Photo |
    some d1 : Day {
        User = u1
        Influencer = none
        Photo = p1
        Ad = p1
        Day = d1
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = none->none
        User <: posts = u1->p1
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = p1->d1
    }
} for exactly 1 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj u1, u2, u3 : User |
    some disj p1, p2, p3 : Photo |
    some d1 : Day {
        User = u1 + u2 + u3
        Influencer = none
        Photo = p1 + p2 + p3
        Ad = p1 + p2
        Day = d1
        User <: follows = u1->u3 + u3->u1
        User <: sees = u1->p1 + u1->p2 + u1->p3 + u2->p1 + u2->p2 + u3->p2
        User <: posts = u1->p1 + u2->p2 + u3->p3
        User <: suggested = u1->u2
        Photo <: date = p1->d1 + p2->d1 + p3->d1
    }
} for exactly 3 User, exactly 3 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

    some disj wk1, wk2 : Worker |
    some disj p1 : Product {
        Workstation = ws1 + ws2
        begin = ws1
        end = ws2
        Worker = wk1 + wk2
        Human = wk1
        Robot = wk2
        Product = none
        Material = none
        Component = none
        Dangerous = none

valid:
run PositiveScenario1 {
    some disj w1 : Workstation |
    some disj h1 : Worker |
    some disj c1, c2 : Product {
        Workstation = w1
        begin = w1
        end = w1
        Worker = h1
        Human = h1
        Robot = none
        Product = c1 + c2
        Component = c1 + c2
        Material = none
        Dangerous = none
        Workstation <: workers = w1->h1
        Workstation <: succ = none->none
        Product <: parts = c1->c2 + c2->c1
        Component <: workstation = c1->w1 + c2->w1
    }
} for exactly 1 Workstation, exactly 1 Worker, exactly 2 Product expect 1

run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p, q : Person |
    some c : Course |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p + q
        Professor = p + q
        Student = q
        Course = c
        Project = none
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p->c
        Person <: enrolled = q->c
        Person <: projects = none->none
        Course <: projects = none->none
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 0 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p, q, s : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some x : Project |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p + q + s
        Professor = p + q
        Student = q + s
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = x
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p->c1 + q->c2
        Person <: enrolled = q->c1 + s->c1
        Person <: projects = s->x
        Course <: projects = c1->x
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p, q, r : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some disj x, y : Project |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p + q + r
        Professor = p + q + r
        Student = q + r
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = x + y
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p->c1 + q->c2
        Person <: enrolled = q->c1 + r->c2
        Person <: projects = q->x + r->y
        Course <: projects = c1->x + c2->y
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 2 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p1, p2, p3 : Person |
    some disj c1 : Course |
    some disj pr1 : Project |
    some disj g1, g2 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + p3
        Professor = p1
        Student = p2 + p3
        Course = c1
        Project = pr1
        Grade = g1 + g2
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + p3->c1
        Person <: projects = p2->pr1
        Course <: projects = c1->pr1
        Course <: grades = c1->p2->g2 + c1->p3->g1
        Grade <: next = g1->g2
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 2 Grade expect 0
